verses.1: And he walked in pride and in arrogance of heart.
verses.2: For the sun stood still in the midst of heaven until he destroyed the armies of the Canaanites, the Hivites, the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Jebusites, and their kings; he slew them and bound their feet in their necks, and slew them with the edge of the sword, and cast down hailstones and covered them with stones.
verses.3: And he walked in every wicked and evil deed and in violence.
verses.4: And that which we have said before, he devours and consumes and swallows up.
verses.5: Kings in a single day, and by his prayer he made the sun stand still in Gibeon, that he might destroy their armies, and he slew them at one time, as many as
verses.6: And he did not believe in God, that He is his Creator, who said, 'My days have become like the days of heaven.'
verses.7: And he thought in his heart that the sun would be darkened because of him.
verses.8: And he rises up by the way and dwells in the land of Zebulun, and he takes Sheba and Macedonia, and he takes Sisa from Samaria and gives him to the people of Syria.
verses.9: And he dwells as far as the region of Kedar, and he spreads out as far as Sidon, and he does work in Achaia, and he lifts up his neck as far as the sea of Tiberias, and he is tossed about and spreads his message as far as the sea of India.
verses.10: And thus he lifts up his neck as far as heaven.
verses.11: And there is no searching out of his head, but in all evil and corruption.
verses.12: And all his way is in darkness and gloom and corruption and deceit and violence and the shedding of blood.
verses.13: And all his conduct, which hates God, he does as Sabellius taught, who chose evil and injustice and oppression, and he kindles the coals of death and does not quench the fire.
verses.14: And the kings of the nations also he brought under his hand and slew them.
verses.15: And he established angels of war, and many nations he subdued and made them serve as he pleased.
verses.16: And he did not cease, and there was nothing that he left undone from the sea of Tarshish as far as the sea of Jericho.
verses.17: And he worships idols and eats sacrifices to the dead and blood, and offers sacrifice to the gods; and there is no justice in him, but in all his ways there is no justice or right or truth, for he has become a terror to the nations that are under his hand, and he makes them do work as he pleases.
verses.18: And there is no fear of God before their eyes, for everyone who is foolish passes before him, and he walks in arrogance before God his Creator.
verses.19: And he does not remember that his God and Lord will repay him according to the evil he has done to his neighbor, on the day when He seizes him in his wrath.
verses.20: And he will be punished at that time, just as He punished the sinners who were before them; for He says, 'I am the Lord, who punishes the wicked who do not walk in my commandments, and so that their memory may perish from the earth.'
verses.21: And the wicked will be repaid according to the evil they have done.
verses.22: But to those who do good, good things will be given to them from God.
verses.23: And just as Joshua destroyed the kings of Canaan at one time, so
verses.24: thus will He recompense those who have provoked God by the evil of their deeds.
